theme: Trip day — the girls arrive and the road to Orlando begins.
greeting: The calendar's clear, Dan, but today's real work is logistics: pickup at three, then the drive to the Orlando villa. Get the car and a grocery plan settled before you roll.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Orlando rental car
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV out of TPA is what the whole drive rides on — pickup is at 3 and the villa is tonight. If it isn't already booked, lock it before you leave for the girls.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets are the last open item
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 26–27 Disney weekend is otherwise set — six tickets remain. Check park-reservation rules and whether a Magic Kingdom Halloween party night shifts which park you pick.

needsAttention.title: Grocery stop before the villa
needsAttention.detail: The Royal Palms villa has a kitchen — slot a grocery run near St Pete or on the Orlando end into today's drive so five nights with six people don't all become dinners out.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out — hold a refundable one now; the Pathfinder is south until spring.

flagged.title: PRISM board-directors summit
flagged.detail: The LGBTQ corporate directors network (now rebranded PRISM) opened registration for its NYC annual summit — worth a look for the board search.

flagged.title: Oct 3 island birthday invite
flagged.detail: Friends invited you and Mike to Marie's birthday Oct 3 at the Coke Bottle House — you'd have the girls that day.

inbox.noise: Mostly newsletters, alumni mail, and shop promos — Foreign Affairs, NPR, Duke, JetBlue, Chairish and the rest.

recipe.title: Braised Pheasant with Mushrooms and Bacon
recipe.why: Autumn's game and wild mushrooms want a slow braise as the evenings turn cool.

tasks.title: Passport prep — packet + appointment for the 4 girls
Confirm St Pete Airbnb (Sep 27–Oct 5) converted from pending

acts.line: An open calendar with nothing scheduled — the last quiet stretch before the girls arrive.
The 3 PM pickup anchors everything; have the car confirmed and a grocery plan in hand before you go.
On the road to the Orlando villa — and Claire's St Pete appointment lands tomorrow at 10:20 AM.
